claims: search/exact/homotopy/N29.md (169a827, 2026-10-11T23:01:11Z) reports that the side of the source's s(29) record configuration, 5.93383346267692918968946061635201913843383418107788697463882591508025..., is a root of an irreducible integer polynomial p of degree 7213 (leading coefficient 325 digits, height 5074 digits), which is therefore its minimal polynomial, found by homotopy continuation: 7,209 regular roots from 44,448 polyhedral paths, and 4 more recovered algebraically from a K = 4 lattice. It rates irreducibility (irred.py, degree patterns modulo 12 primes near 2^61), a Krawczyk enclosure of radius 1e-50 of the eliminated system's zero (krawczyk.py) and the link of that zero to a root of p (link.py) rigorous, and the identities F_k(tau) = 0, Sn(tau) = x Sd(tau) in Q[x]/(p) and the consistency of the full 152-row contact system Monte Carlo (verify_mod.py and contacts_mod.py, modulo 50 and 21 random 62-bit primes). It does not check non-overlap at the exact point, and the coefficients (work/n29_poly_q4.json, 27 MB) are gitignored and not published.

tasks/exact-minpoly/grade-C.md (0d0146e and e493eea, 2026-10-12T02:29:22Z and 02:38:47Z) states Theorem C, a sufficient condition for a configuration with exact flat motions to be a local minimum of the side (IsLocalMinPacking: no packing in a smaller square within a pose-space ball, squares matched by index, angles modulo 90 degrees), with a paper proof, and reports search/exact/gradec.py's batch over the 250 source configurations of field degree at most 4 in search/exact/minpoly/results.json, exact in the number field with signs by interval arithmetic: 231 VALID with every load-bearing incidence as a row; n = 230 and 261 VALID with GRADEC_DROPZERO=1, which drops 24 rows that carry zero force in every multiplier vector; 17 timeouts at the 30-minute cap (n = 174, 201, 204, 231, 234, 257, 262, 274, 275, 295, 296, 299 and 308 to 312). So 233 of the 250 are VALID. gradec_runs/_status.txt and _dropzero_status.txt give each run's exit code; the certificates, their inputs and the logs are gitignored and not published.
